summary: Security audit remediation verified. 53/53 backend tests PASS (previous 24 regression + 29 new security assertions). All four SEC findings are properly remediated. SEC-001: /api/subscription/checkout-page rejects all 9 malformed subscription_id payloads with 400 (URL-encoded </script>, raw </script>, path traversal sub_../../etc, quote-break sub_' onerror=, empty, non-ascii, wrong-case SUB_, too-long sub_A*33, too-short sub_ABCDE); valid-shape-but-missing returns 404; on a real DB-persisted sub_id, response is 200 HTML with CSP delivered via <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> containing checkout.razorpay.com, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, and the subscription_id is JSON-quoted inside the JS block; no <script>alert</script> reflection. SEC-002: JWT_SECRET is 64 chars of urlsafe random (not placeholder). Tokens hand-signed with weak secrets (placeholder, secret, changeme, dev-secret, crack-secret) return 401. Fresh signup token works on /auth/me. Existing test1@example.com/secret123 login re-issues a working token. server.py raises RuntimeError at import when JWT_SECRET is placeholder or <32 chars (verified via direct import). SEC-003: RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is 64 chars random (not placeholder). Forged and missing signatures return 400. rzp_events has a unique index on event_id (verified via MongoClient.index_information). SEC-004: /food/analyze returns 422 for image_base64 > 8MB (Pydantic max_length), 413 for base64 that decodes to > 5MB (in-code MAX_IMAGE_BYTES). Generic Gemini error path returns 502 with 'AI analysis failed' and never leaks 'gemini/google/traceback/api key/vertex'. /food/log returns 422 for food_name>120 chars, calories>20000, calories<0, image_b64>250000 chars; valid small payload accepts. New: /auth/signup returns 422 for 7-char password, 200 for 8-char. Regression: full existing suite passes (auth, profile, food CRUD, /subscription/me trial, live Razorpay checkout, idempotency, expired-trial 402 paywall, /food/today macro totals, webhook/callback HMAC 400, IDOR — user B cannot delete user A's food log).

minor.issue: CSP is delivered only via <meta http-equiv> inside HTML, not as a Content-Security-Policy response header. <meta> CSP is honored by browsers but has known limitations (no report-uri, no frame-ancestors). Recommend adding CSP as an actual HTTP response header for defense-in-depth. Current placement still mitigates SEC-001.

Idempotency whitelist checks status in {authenticated, active, pending, created}. If Razorpay ever returns a status outside this set (e.g. 'halted'), a duplicate subscription would be created. Consider gating solely on razorpay_subscription_id existence. Carry-over from iteration 2.

action_items: (Optional, defense-in-depth) Add Content-Security-Policy as an HTTP response header on GET /api/subscription/checkout-page in addition to the current <meta> tag — some CSP directives (frame-ancestors, report-to) are ignored when delivered via <meta>.
(Optional) Tighten /subscription/checkout idempotency to gate on razorpay_subscription_id existence rather than status whitelist.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 fix is layered: (1) RZP_ID_RE allowlist ^sub_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,32}$ rejects all XSS payloads at the boundary; (2) DB lookup makes ID enumeration return 404; (3) js_str() JSON-encodes values and rewrites </->\/ for defense-in-depth. Even without the escape, alphanumeric-only inputs cannot break out of a JSON string literal. Robust.
SEC-002 boot-guard (server.py:34-35) fires on module import — a placeholder or <32-char JWT_SECRET raises RuntimeError before FastAPI starts. Verified live.

SEC-003 webhook has fail-closed 503 when RZP_WEBHOOK_LIVE is false (server.py:439-440) — good. hmac.compare_digest used for constant-time compare. rzp_events unique index created at startup (server.py:635) with try/except so a duplicate event_id insert raises and the handler returns {'ok': True} (idempotent replay).

SEC-004: Pydantic Field(max_length=8*1024*1024) on image_base64 provides fast rejection before body parse. The (len*3)//4 approx decoded-size check (server.py:502-506) uses correct base64 arithmetic. Generic 502 error message replaces provider-specific detail. FoodLogBody has proper bounded fields.
server.py is 643 lines — still under 700 but growing. When adding webhook dunning or refund flows, split into routers/{auth,subscription,food}.py.

One test data-quality note (fixed): backend_test.py::TestAuth::test_signup_duplicate_email_rejected previously sent password='x' which now returns 422 (Pydantic) before reaching the duplicate-email 400 branch — I updated the test to use 'secret123' so it exercises the intended code path.
